tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: The current visitor's shopping cart: items, quantities, prices and totals.

tools.name: get_page_content
tools.description: Get this page, or another page on this same website, as Markdown - the same content this site returns to a request with Accept: text/markdown. Only URLs on this site are accepted.

url.description: A URL on this site to fetch as Markdown. Defaults to the current page.

tools.name: go_to_checkout
tools.description: Opens the checkout page for the current cart; a person completes payment there. This tool never pays, and refuses to navigate when the cart is empty.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search this website for articles, attractions, shows and tips.

limit.description: Maximum number of results, clamped to 1-20 (default 10).

tools.name: search_site_form
tools.description: Search NewYork.se for articles, attractions, shows and tips

tools.name: site_info
tools.description: Identity of this website and the current page: site name, domain, locale, market (and country, when known), home URL, and the page's canonical URL and title.
